backend/main.mo: Actor managing user profiles, Stripe config and sessions, access control, and simple data plan storage with authorization checks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features, related files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing short summaries for various frontend source files and components.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based stylesheet defining theme variables and dark mode values.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the app root and loading the main script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component handling simple route-based rendering for payment pages and wrapping content in React Query.
frontend/src/components/DataPlansSection: Component displaying data plans with network selection, plan cards, Stripe payment, WhatsApp ordering, and bank transfer modal.
frontend/src/components/IBNFooter.tsx: Footer with brand info, quick links, contact details, and social icons using smooth scrolling and WhatsApp helpers.
frontend/src/components/IBNHeader.tsx: Header component showing logo, contact button, and admin dropdown with Stripe and bank setup dialogs based on user role.
frontend/src/components/LandingPage.tsx: Main landing page assembling hero, feature sections, data plans, testimonials, FAQ, and WhatsApp CTA.
frontend/src/components/LandingPageSecti: FAQ section rendering a list of common questions using an accordion component.
Explains the service process in three steps using styled cards.
Displays customer testimonials with ratings and avatars in a card grid.
frontend/src/components/payments/BankTra: Admin form for viewing and updating bank transfer details with validation and save handling.
Dialog that displays bank transfer details with copy-to-clipboard actions, and shows an unavailable message if details are missing.
frontend/src/components/payments/Payment: UI screen shown when a payment is cancelled, offering retry and WhatsApp support links.
Page that verifies a Stripe session ID, shows success or failure states, and displays basic transaction info.
frontend/src/components/payments/PayNowB: Button that initiates Stripe checkout sessions, requiring Internet Identity login and handling errors and login prompts.
frontend/src/components/payments/StripeA: Admin form for configuring Stripe secret keys and allowed countries, with validation and success state handling.
frontend/src/components/WhatsAppCTA.tsx: Reusable WhatsApp CTA button generating a link with optional message and number display.
frontend/src/data/mobileNetworkPlans.ts: Static definitions of mobile network data plans including pricing, data amounts, validity, and feature lists.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity, refreshing dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, loading stored identities and handling login and logout flows.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for Stripe setup, checkout sessions, bank details, and admin checks using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables for light and dark theme colors and typography.
frontend/src/lib/whatsapp.ts: Generates WhatsApp URLs with optional prefilled messages and structured order details.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers and mounts the root component.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters, including sessionStorage support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, radius, fonts, and plugins using CSS variable-based OKLCH palettes.
project_state.json: Defines project metadata, feature list, and notes for building the IBN data-selling app, including UI, branding, WhatsApp contact, and added bank‑transfer payment support.
